name: Soul of the Rogue
body:
Associated Skills: Disable Device, Disguise, Sleight of Hand, Stealth

Associated Veils: Bands of the Void, Darkholds, Darkwalker Hood, Ebon Blaze, Pooling Black, Robe of the Forgotten Deity, Snakehandler’s Gauntlets, Stalker’s Tabi

Finesse Training (Ex)

At 1st level, you tap into the finesse of the rogue’s soul, granting you Weapon Finesse as a bonus feat.

At 5th level, you can select any one type of weapon that can be used with Weapon Finesse (such as rapiers or daggers). Whenever you make a successful melee attack with the selected weapon, you may add your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier to the damage roll. If any effect would prevent you from adding your Strength modifier to the damage roll, you do not add your Dexterity modifier. If an effect would modify your Strength bonus (such as wielding a weapon two-handed or in your off-hand), this modification applies to this ability as well. You can select a second weapon at 11th level and a third at 17th level.

Trap Finding (Ex)

At 1st level, tapping into the rogue’s soul grants you talent at finding and disabling traps. You gain a +1 bonus, +1 per two class levels beyond 1st, to Perception checks to locate traps and on Disable Device checks. You can also use Disable Device to disarm magic traps.

Sneak Attack (Ex)

At 2nd level, and every 3 levels thereafter, you deal an additional 1d6 points of precision damage to creatures that are denied their Dexterity bonus to AC against you, or that you are flanking. You do not gain this extra damage against creatures who have concealment, and only while you are within 30 feet of a creature when using a ranged weapon. If you are using a nonlethal weapon, or attacking nonlethally, this damage is nonlethal as well. If you get a sneak attack bonus from another source, the bonuses on damage stack.
